question: What are the main benefits of Business Central?
answer: The main benefits are having one connected system for finance, sales, stock, and service, built-in AI that automates routine work, ready-made reports and dashboards, and a subscription cost that is easy to plan for. It also works closely with Outlook, Excel, and Teams.

question: Is Business Central only for large companies?
answer: No, Business Central is built specifically for small and mid-sized businesses. It scales with a growing company, so you can add users and functionality as you need them, without paying for capacity you do not use yet.

question: How much does Business Central cost?
answer:
Microsoft prices Business Central per user, per month, on a yearly subscription. There are three licence types: Essentials, Premium (which adds service management and manufacturing capabilities), and Team Members for limited, read-only style access.

Your final cost depends on how many users you need and which licence fits your business, so it is worth getting a tailored quote.

question: How long does a Business Central implementation take?
answer: A standard implementation can take a matter of weeks. A more complex project with custom integrations or data migration from an older system can take a few months. Your Dynamics Square consultant will give you a realistic timeline based on your specific requirements.

question: Can Business Central replace my current accounting software or older ERP system?
answer: Yes, Business Central includes built-in migration tools for moving data across from common accounting packages, Dynamics NAV, Dynamics GP, and other ERP systems, so you keep your financial history intact when you switch.
